correctness.rationale: Each graph has 27abc odd vertices, degree 6, so six matchings cannot color 3N edges: lower bound 7. The 81-edge ternary three-torus seed is explicitly specified in the actual certificate.json table. Independently constructed graph adjacency, 81 unique undirected edges, all 27 vertex incidence lists and all 81 simple 4-cycles, verifying six distinct incident colors and four distinct edge colors per 4-cycle; seven colors occur with multiplicities (11,11,12,12,11,12,12). Reduction modulo 3 from any odd-multiple-of-three cycle is a locally bijective covering onto C3. Every larger graph 4-cycle uses two directions and descends to a seed 4-cycle, so pullback certifies infinite family. Finite certificate alone would not establish the general theorem; parity plus graph covering does.
